name: Clearwater Beach
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Clearwater Beach?
answer_short: Street-legal LSVs yes; plain golf carts only on designated streets. Dunedin has designated golf cart streets on its official map. LSVs may use roads posted 35 mph or less in Clearwater Beach.

rules.rule: Plain golf carts only on roads a city or county has designated and signed for carts
Registered, insured LSVs on roads posted 35 mph or less; cross faster roads only at intersections
Golf carts on the city's designated streets
rules.citation: City of Dunedin golf cart map

banned_roads.name: Memorial Causeway and Gulf to Bay Blvd

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Clearwater Beach?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Not on causeways posted higher. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart in Dunedin?
faq.a: Yes, on the streets shown on the city's golf cart map.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart on Clearwater Beach?
faq.a: Only on roads the city designates for carts. Street-legal LSVs may use roads posted 35 mph or less.
